name: Mirror Leech Telegram Bot
description: A Telegram bot for mirroring/leeching files to Google Drive, Telegram, and rclone remotes.

OWNER_ID.description: The Telegram User ID of the owner

TELEGRAM_API.description: The Telegram API ID from https://my.telegram.org

TELEGRAM_HASH.description: The Telegram API Hash from https://my.telegram.org

GDRIVE_ID.description: Google Drive Folder ID or 'root'. Required if DEFAULT_UPLOAD is 'gd'.

DATABASE_URL.description: MongoDB Connection String. Recommended for saving settings.
